- Confirm ARR delta (net new ARR) that should be reflected in the forecast model. If uncertain, enter a conservative number and mark it as estimate.
- Upload any PO drafts or emails to the HubSpot attachments and paste the link in your reply.

Attached: forecast-template.xlsx (please paste final ARR into column "Ops_Reported_ARR"). HubSpot link and forecast snapshot will be updated after we get confirmations.

Thanks — a short reply with the three bullets above is fine.
